item.title: Delhi High Court sets aside “mechanical” rejection of plea for premature release of Bangladeshi convict
item.description: Holding that the Sentence Review Board cannot reject premature release solely on the gravity of the offence, the Delhi High Court said such decisions must consider custodial conduct, rehabilitative indicators, and other relevant factors under the 2004 Policy and Delhi Prison Rules, 2018. The post Delhi High Court sets aside “mechanical” rejection of plea for premature release of Bangladeshi convict appeared first on SCC Times.
